product.description:
David Balfour — Robert Louis Stevenson

A 1913 Charles Scribner’s Sons illustrated printing of David Balfour: Being Memoirs of His Adventures at Home and Abroad. Green ribbed cloth with a gilt monogram on the front and gilt lettering on the spine.

Condition

Acceptable antique hardcover. No dust jacket. Cloth shows rubbing, scuffs, small marks, and wear to corners and spine ends. Pages and uneven page edges are age toned, with scattered spotting/foxing, edge creasing and small nicks. Some hinge wear is visible. The photographed black-and-white frontispiece and its tissue guard are present. Not inspected page by page; completeness of all text and illustrations and binding strength have not been fully checked. Please review all nine photographs.

Details

  • Title: David Balfour
  • Author: Robert Louis Stevenson
  • Publisher: Charles Scribner’s Sons, New York
  • Title-page date: 1913; copyright: 1893
  • Later illustrated printing
  • English-language green cloth hardcover
  • Approximately 7¾ × 5⅜ × 1¼ inches; book-only weight 1 lb 4.7 oz

Included

One hardcover book. No dust jacket.

Packing & Shipping

Protected against moisture and packed in a rigid box with corner protection. Buyer-paid calculated USPS Media Mail shipping. Two-business-day handling. Returns accepted within 30 days; buyer pays return shipping.
